//REGION One reaction: once per game (ALFSV_React_* flag), approval for every avatar, overhead line

PROC
PROC_ALFSV_React((FLAG)_Once, (INTEGER)_Value, (STRING)_AD)
AND
DB_ALFSV_IsCompanion(1)
AND
NOT DB_GlobalFlag(_Once)
THEN
PROC_GlobalSetFlagAndCache(_Once);
PROC_ChangeApprovalRatingForAllAvatars(S_DEN_Bard_4a405fba-3000-4c63-97e5-a8001ebb883c, _Value);
PROC_ALFSV_React_AD(_AD);

PROC
PROC_ALFSV_React_AD((STRING)_AD)
AND
_AD != ""
THEN
PROC_ALFSV_Place_Request(_AD);

//END_REGION

//REGION 18. Killing tieflings: -10 for each, like Wyll (Act1_OriginMoments_Wyll.txt:4-6, _GLO_Shared_Origins.txt 'Killing NPCs')

PROC
PROC_ALFSV_React_CaredFaction()
AND
DB_ALFSV_IsCompanion(1)
THEN
DB_CompanionCaredFaction((CHARACTER)S_DEN_Bard_4a405fba-3000-4c63-97e5-a8001ebb883c, (FACTION)ACT1_DEN_Tieflings_ca9de2d9-9022-9215-6d9b-676d916dcb5a, -10, 1, 0);
DB_CompanionCaredFaction((CHARACTER)S_DEN_Bard_4a405fba-3000-4c63-97e5-a8001ebb883c, (FACTION)ACT1_DEN_AttackOnDen_NPC_08f28bce-a261-35e2-9914-6aa8b3eea155, -10, 1, 0);

IF
DB_ALFSV_IsCompanion(1)
THEN
PROC_ALFSV_React_CaredFaction();

// the first such death: her line (the game inserts this fact on every reaction; it triggers once)
IF
DB_CompanionReactedToFactionMemberDeath(S_DEN_Bard_4a405fba-3000-4c63-97e5-a8001ebb883c, _Faction)
THEN
PROC_ALFSV_React_AD("React_TieflingKilled");

//END_REGION

//REGION 19. A good performance near her (PERFORM_POSITIVE, _CRIME_BardReactions.txt): +1, at most +5 in act 1

IF
StatusApplied(_Performer, "PERFORM_POSITIVE", _, _)
AND
DB_PartyMembers((CHARACTER)_Performer)
AND
_Performer != S_DEN_Bard_4a405fba-3000-4c63-97e5-a8001ebb883c
AND
DB_ALFSV_IsCompanion(1)
AND
DB_Players(S_DEN_Bard_4a405fba-3000-4c63-97e5-a8001ebb883c)
AND
IsInCombat(_Performer, 0)
AND
QRY_SpeakerIsInDialogRange(_Performer, S_DEN_Bard_4a405fba-3000-4c63-97e5-a8001ebb883c)
AND
QRY_ALFSV_Chapters_InAct(1)
THEN
PROC_ALFSV_React_Perform();

PROC
PROC_ALFSV_React_Perform()
AND
NOT DB_ALFSV_React_Performed(_)
THEN
DB_ALFSV_React_Performed(0);

PROC
PROC_ALFSV_React_Perform()
AND
DB_ALFSV_React_Performed(_N)
AND
_N < 5
AND
IntegerSum(_N, 1, _Next)
THEN
NOT DB_ALFSV_React_Performed(_N);
DB_ALFSV_React_Performed(_Next);
PROC_ChangeApprovalRatingForAllAvatars(S_DEN_Bard_4a405fba-3000-4c63-97e5-a8001ebb883c, 1);

//END_REGION
EXITSECTION
